meta.title: Comparative Politics knowledge network, c. 1959-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in comparative politics: democratization and backsliding, authoritarian institutions and information control, Chinese politics, state capacity and development, redistribution and political economy, parties, populism, clientelism, ethnicity, contention, corruption, gender and institutional theory. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json; works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref plus anchoring classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works imported from the IPE, security and IR maps keep their verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. Anchors are checked in Crossref separately; see each node's `verified` field. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
